draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Tirunelveli, or Nellai as everyone calls it! This city on the west bank of the Thamirabarani has more than two thousand years of recorded history, and was a major town of the Early Pandyas back in the Sangam period.
draft.hungryLine: Ask anyone in Nellai where they eat, the locals always know the best plate in town.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Head down to the Thamirabarani River, the city grew up on its west bank.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a quiet spot by the Thamirabarani in the evening and watch the river go by.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Veerapandiya Kattabomman and his Palaiyakkarars fought the East India Company right on the outskirts of this city, from 1797 to 1801.

spots.name: Thamirabarani River
spots.detail: Right by the city · The river Tirunelveli grew up beside, on its west bank

tips.title: Say Nellai.
tips.body: Tirunelveli is widely known as Nellai, and older British maps call the district Tinnevelly.

tips.title: Read up on the Polygar War.
tips.body: Kattabomman's fight against the Company happened around this city, and it makes the place come alive.

story.title: A Pandya town
story.body: Tirunelveli was a major town of the Early Pandyas in the Sangam period. Its recorded history goes back more than two thousand years.

story.title: Cholas and beyond
story.body: The Cholas took over in the 11th century CE. Later came the Later Pandyas, the Vijayanagara Empire and the Madurai Nayaks.

story.title: The Polygar War
story.body: Tinnevelly district was formed on 1 September 1790 under the East India Company. From 1797 to 1801, Kattabomman's Palaiyakkarars fought the Company on the city's outskirts.

story.title: Seventh largest city
story.body: Nellai is the headquarters of Tirunelveli District. With 473,637 people in 2011, it was the seventh-largest city in Tamil Nadu.
